meaning:
Kodak drops a similar bar on “No Flockin” from his 2014 mixtape, Heart of the Projects.

Is it you? Damn, my nigga, what the hell got into you?

In “No Flockin,” Kodak expands on how the hallucinogenic drug known as flocka (or flakka) affects the people of his community, some of which, he knows personally.
